behavior.identity: Existing SHA-256 IDs remain stable; evidence matching supplements exact identity within the same card/billing date.
behavior.crossFormat: Normalize presentation punctuation/parentheses, compare signed billed cents/date/merchant, protect installment and transaction-reference evidence, and recognize the exact legacy Cal foreign-original representation.
behavior.multiplicity: One saved transaction can match only one incoming occurrence; exact matches reserve rows before evidence matching.
behavior.duplicates: Whole duplicate group is excluded from another financial import; no replacement or additional financial approval is needed. Source files remain available.
behavior.partialOverlap: Only excess/new rows proceed through the original explicit review and atomic import.
behavior.guardrails: Changed amounts/originals/installments/known currencies/references, missing rows and ambiguous evidence remain reviewable; unchanged IDs/categories/records are retained.
behavior.scope: Only five duplicate-matching/UI/test files differ from previous live source; Stage 2 remains excluded.
